messages.content: I need to settle the fourth night for Minneapolis. Compare keeping the Plymouth room and car through Friday with moving to an airport hotel Thursday. Include every room and transport charge that would be reimbursable.

The Plymouth hotel can extend the same room for Thursday at $184 plus $27.60 tax, with parking included. Keeping the rental through Friday adds $58.40, so that option adds $270 total. You would drive to MSP Friday morning; the hotel's airport car service starts at 7:00 a.m., too late to be useful once travel time and the rental return are included.
And the airport option? Use a hotel with an actual early shuttle, not one that merely says airport shuttle on the listing.

The airport option is $149 plus $22.35 tax for Thursday night. The hotel desk confirmed its shuttle operates around the clock, leaves every 30 minutes overnight and in the early morning, and can take you to Terminal 1 at 6:30 a.m. No advance shuttle reservation is required, but they recommend checking in with the desk Thursday night.
What does it cost to get there after the closing meeting? I will still have the rental car Thursday.

You can drive from the audit site to the airport, return the car Thursday evening, and take the rental facility connection to the hotel shuttle pickup. Ending the rental Thursday instead of Friday removes the $58.40 extra day. There is no separate reimbursable transfer charge unless you choose a rideshare from the rental center; that would be about $14 to $20.
So give me comparable totals. Do not count an optional rideshare in the base amount.

Comparable fourth-night totals are $270 for the Plymouth extension with the extra rental day, versus $171.35 for the airport hotel with the rental returned Thursday. The airport move is $98.65 less. Applied to the current $1,947.40 trip estimate, the airport-hotel plan reduces the estimate to $1,848.75.
Check the practical timing. The closing meeting may run until 5:00, and I do not want a late-arrival problem at the airport hotel.

Allowing roughly 45 to 60 minutes from Plymouth to the airport in Thursday evening traffic, plus about 20 minutes to refuel and return the car, you should reach the hotel around 6:30 to 7:00 p.m. The hotel holds guaranteed reservations through the night. I can add an expected arrival of 7:00 p.m. and a note that the time may shift with traffic.
The flight is at 9:40 Friday. Is 6:30 unnecessarily early?

It is conservative. The 7:00 shuttle should reach Terminal 1 around 7:10 to 7:20, leaving a little over two hours before departure. The 7:30 shuttle would normally work but leaves less recovery time if it fills or is delayed. The hotel confirmed the 6:30 and 7:00 departures both operate Friday morning.
Use the 7:00 shuttle. Before booking, confirm I am not paying twice for Thursday at the Plymouth property.

Your current Plymouth reservation is Monday through Thursday with checkout Thursday morning, covering three nights only. Extending it would create the fourth night; moving to the airport hotel does not overlap any paid lodging night. You will need to check out before the audit Thursday and keep your luggage secured in the rental car until you leave the site.
Book the airport hotel at $171.35, add the late-arrival note, and leave the Plymouth reservation ending Thursday. Also note the 7:00 shuttle in the itinerary.

The airport hotel is booked for Thursday night at $171.35 including tax, with cancellation allowed until 6:00 p.m. Wednesday local time. The reservation notes an expected arrival around 7:00 p.m. after the audit. The Plymouth stay still ends Thursday morning, the rental is now scheduled for return Thursday evening, and the itinerary lists the hotel's 7:00 a.m. Friday shuttle to Terminal 1 for the 9:40 a.m. nonstop. The revised reimbursable trip estimate is $1,848.75; an optional rideshare is not included.
